notes: Curated, human-reviewed module seeds. They cite graph by stable locators (path+qualifiedName+kind);
projection resolves them against the head snapshot and seals prompt/schema/input digests.
seed=true, model=null, verified_by_agent=false: no production model ran. The curator identity
is recorded per-file under curated.*. After editing code, POST /api/review/code/sync to re-project.
If a cited locator no longer resolves, the seed persists as status=rejected and never shadows a good row.
